redshift.label: Approximate redshift from LSR velocity
redshift.note: Signed low-velocity approximation z = v_LSR/c. No LSR-to-heliocentric frame correction; not equivalent to the SDSS spectroscopic redshift.

notes: All table entries, including possible targets. Survey statuses refer to v1p6. PHANGS WISE/GALEX and SDSS MPA-JHU estimates use different methods; no calibration offsets applied. Distance uncertainty is in dex. PHANGS logSigma = log10(Mstar / (pi R90^2)) in Msun/kpc^2, using size_r90 and dist, total stellar mass, a circular area and no inclination correction. This differs from SDSS Mstar/(2 pi R50^2). R90 uncertainties are unavailable; no surface-density uncertainty is estimated. z is the signed low-velocity approximation orient_vlsr / 299792.458 from the catalogue LSR velocity, not a heliocentric SDSS-equivalent redshift. Orientation, morphology and AGN fields retain their source values and masks.
